tool_input.description: Show package scripts, migration SQL, DB config and API digest
Run a debug test to inspect store response and tables

result:
Tags are in place: authors can enter them on the create and edit forms, they show on the list and post pages, and `/posts?tag=<name>` filters the list. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` pass (10 tests, including a new `tests/PostTags.test.ts`), and oxlint is clean. The changes are uncommitted.

The work is in `db/schema.ts` (new `tags` and `post_tags` tables, with a cascading foreign key on each side), a generated migration under `db/migrations/20261018220555_add_tags/`, and new `Tag` and `PostTag` models. `PostController` syncs tags on store and update, filters the index by `tag` (page links keep the filter), and eager-loads tags everywhere posts are read. `PostPayloadSchema` gained a `tags` string field that enforces the naming, length, and five-tag rules. `PostResource` always emits `tags` as a sorted string array. The create, edit, list and post pages were updated, with a shared `TagList` component in `resources/js/components/`. The edit page now receives the same post shape as the show page, with `tags` as an array. Generated `.guren/*.gen.ts` files were regenerated. I did not boot the app in a browser, so the forms and links are verified by typecheck and the in-process tests, not by clicking through.
